space.description: The visited space. Carries the full identity (owner DID + rkey + cid); the record key alone is only a dedup key.

lastVisited.description: When the author most recently visited this space. Bumped on every recorded visit; the 'boards you've visited' list sorts by this.

firstVisited.description: When the author first visited this space. Preserved across re-visits.

main.description: A private-ish bookmark marking a space the author has visited, written to the author's own repo. The record key matches the visited space's record key, so re-visiting overwrites the same record (one per space). Used to populate the author's 'boards you've visited' list quickly, ordered by lastVisited.
